371:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
372:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
373:               g_recovery_index = i;
374:             }
375:         }
376: 
377:       epoch->replay = true;
378:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
379:     }
380:   else
381:     {
382:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
383:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
384:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
385:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
386:     }
387: 
388:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
389:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
390:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
391:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
392:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
393: }

395: static void begin_abort(int result)
396: {
397:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
398: 
399:   if (g_active.busy)
400:     {
401:       g_active.quarantine = true;
402:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
403:     }
404: 
405:   if (probe != NULL)
406:     {
407:       probe->quarantine = true;
408:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
409:     }
410: 
411:   fail_pending(result);
412:   g_probe_requested = false;
413:   select_recovery_epoch();
414: }

416: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
417: {
418:   unsigned int i;
419: 
420:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
421:     {
422:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
423:         {
424:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
425:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
426:         }
427:     }
428: 
429:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
430:   return NULL;
431: }
432: 
433: static int dispatch_locked(void)
434: {
435:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
436:   struct active_transaction *active;
437:   struct logical_channel *channel;
438:   unsigned int i;
439:   int ret;
440: 
441:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
442: 
443:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
444:     {
445:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
446:         {
447:           continue;
448:         }
449: 
450:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
451:       if (ret < 0)
452:         {
453:           return ret;
454:         }
455: 
456:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
457:     }
458: 
459:   if (g_reset_pending)
460:     {
461:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
462:       if (ret < 0)
463:         {
464:           return ret;
465:         }
466: 
467:       g_reset_pending = false;
468:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
469:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
470:     }
471: 
472:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
473:     {
474:       return OK;
475:     }
476: 
477:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
478:     {
479:       channel = &g_channels[i];
480:       if (!channel->queued)
481:         {
482:           continue;
483:         }
484: 
485:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
486:         {
487:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
488:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
489:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
490:             {
491:               continue;
492:             }
493: 
494:           active = &epoch->probe;
495:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
496:             {
497:               return -ENOLINK;
498:             }
499:         }
500:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
501:         {
502:           active = &g_active;
503:           if (active->quarantine)
504:             {
505:               return -ENOLINK;
506:             }
507:         }
508:       else
509:         {
510:           return OK;
511:         }
512: 
513:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
514:         {
515:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
516:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
517:                  sizeof(active->message));
518:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
519:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
520:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
521:             g_channel_ids[i]);
522:         }
523: 
524:       active->callback = channel->callback;
525:       active->arg = channel->arg;
526:       active->channel_index = i;
527:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
528:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
529:       if (ret < 0)
530:         {
531:           return ret;
532:         }
533: 
534:       active->busy = true;
535:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
536:         {
537:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
538:             {
539:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
540:             }
541: 
542:           g_probe_attempts++;
543:           g_stats.probes++;
544:         }
545: 
546:       return OK;
547:     }
548: 
549:   return OK;
550: }

552: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
553:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
554: {
555:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
556: 
557:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
558:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
559:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
560:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
561:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
562:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
563:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
564: }
565: 
566: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
567: {
568:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
569:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
570:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
571: }
572: 
573: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
574: {
575:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
576:   struct active_transaction *active;
577:   bool replay;
578:   int result;
579: 
580:   active = busy_probe();
581:   if (active == NULL)
582:     {
583:       active = &g_active;
584:     }
585: 
586:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
587:     {
588:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
589:       return;
590:     }
591: 
592:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
593:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
594:     {
595:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
596: 
597:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
598:       return;
599:     }
600: 
601:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
602:     {
603:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
604:       return;
605:     }
606: 
607:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
608:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
609: 
610:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
611:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
612:     {
613:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
614:     }
615: 
616:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
617:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
618:   if (replay)
619:     {
620:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
621:       unsigned int i;
622: 
623:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
624:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
625:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
626:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
627:        */
628: 
629:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
630:       g_active.quarantine = false;
631:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
632:         {
633:           if (i != replay_index)
634:             {
635:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
636:             }
637:         }
638: 
639:       select_recovery_epoch();
640:       (void)dispatch_locked();
641:       return;
642:     }
643: 
644:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
645: 
646:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
647:     {
648:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
649:         {
650:           release_recovery_slots();
651:           g_recovery_index = 0;
652:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
653:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
654:         }
655:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
656:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
657:         {
658:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
659:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
660:            */
661:         }
662:       else
663:         {
664:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
665:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
666:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
667:         }
668:     }
669: 
670:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
671:            result < 0)
672:     {
673:       begin_abort(result);
674:     }
675: 
676:   (void)dispatch_locked();
677: }
678: 
679: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
680: {
681:   struct ack_slot *slot;
682:   unsigned int rx_index;
683:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
684:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
685:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
686:   uint8_t state = 0;
687:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
688: 
689:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
690:     {
691:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
692:       if (slot == NULL)
693:         {
694:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
695:           return -EAGAIN;
696:         }
697:     }
698:   else
699:     {
700:       slot = NULL;
701:     }
702: 
703:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
704:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
705:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
706:     {
707:       g_stats.bad_header++;
708:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
709:     }
710:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
711:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
712:     {
713:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
714:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
715:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
716:         {
717:           if (slot != NULL)
718:             {
719:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
720:             }
721: 
722:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
723:           return -EAGAIN;
724:         }
725:       else if (ret < 0)
726:         {
727:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
728:         }
729:     }
730:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
731:     {
732:       g_pwc_rx(message);
733:       ret = OK;
734:     }
735:   else
736:     {
737:       g_stats.unsupported++;
738:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
739:     }
740: 
741:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
742:     {
743:       return OK;
744:     }
745: 
746:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
747:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
748:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
749:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
750:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
751: 
752:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
753:     {
754:       g_probe_requested = true;
755:     }
756: 
757:   (void)dispatch_locked();
758:   return OK;
759: }

761: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
762: {
763:   irqstate_t flags;
764:   uint8_t control;
765: 
766:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
767:   g_stats.rx++;
768:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
769: 
770:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
771:     {
772:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
773:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
774:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
775:         {
776:           g_stats.bad_header++;
777:         }
778:       else
779:         {
780:           g_stats.resets++;
781:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
782:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
783:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
784:         }
785:     }
786:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
787:     {
788:       handle_ack(message);
789:     }
790:   else
791:     {
792:       int ret = handle_command(message);
793: 
794:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
795:         {
796:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
797:           return ret;
798:         }
799:     }
800: 
801:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
802:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
803:   return OK;
804: }

806: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
807: {
808:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
809:   int ret;
810: 
811:   (void)argc;
812:   (void)argv;
813:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
814:   g_diag_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
815:   nxsem_post(&g_diag_worker_ready_sem);
816:   if (ret < 0)
817:     {
818:       return -EXDEV;
819:     }
820: 
821:   for (;;)
822:     {
823:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
824:       irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
825:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
826:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
827:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
828:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
829:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
830:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
831: 
832:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
833:       if (reported == state)
834:         {
835:           continue;
836:         }
837: 
838:       reported = state;
839:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
840:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
841:         {
842:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
843:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
844:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
845:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
846:         }
847: 
848:       if (callback != NULL)
849:         {
850:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
851:         }
852:     }
853: 
854:   return OK;
855: }

857: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
858: {
859:   int ret;
860: 
861:   (void)argc;
862:   (void)argv;
863:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
864:   g_tx_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
865:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_worker_ready_sem);
866:   if (ret < 0)
867:     {
868:       return -EXDEV;
869:     }
870: 
871:   for (;;)
872:     {
873:       struct active_transaction *probe;
874:       irqstate_t flags;
875:       bool request_probe;
876: 
877:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
878:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
879: 
880:       probe = busy_probe();
881:       if ((g_active.busy &&
882:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
883:           (probe != NULL &&
884:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
885:         {
886:           g_stats.timeout++;
887:           if (probe != NULL)
888:             {
889:               probe->quarantine = true;
890:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
891:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
892:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
893:             }
894:           else
895:             {
896:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
897:             }
898:         }
899: 
900:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
901:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
902:         {
903:           select_recovery_epoch();
904:         }
905: 
906:       (void)dispatch_locked();
907:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
908:         {
909:           g_probe_requested = false;
910:         }
911: 
912:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
913:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
914:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
915:       if (request_probe)
916:         {
917:           g_probe_requested = false;
918:         }
919: 
920:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
921: 
922:       if (request_probe)
923:         {
924:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
925:         }
926:     }
927: 
928:   return OK;
929: }

1050: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
1051:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,

216: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
217: 	}

220: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;

223: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
224: {
225: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
226: 
227: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
228: 
229: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
230: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
231: 
232: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
233: 	{
234: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
235: 	}
236: 	else
237: 	{
238: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
242: 	{
243: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
244: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
245: 		tx_fail = 1;
246: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
250: 	{
251: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
252: 		tx_fail = 1;
253: 
254: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
255: 	}
256: 
257: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
258: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
259: 	#endif
260: 
261: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
262: 
263: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
264: 
265: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
266: 	{
267: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
268: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
269: 	}
270: 	else
271: 	{
272: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
273: 
274: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
275: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
276: 
277: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
278: 		{
279: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
280: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
281: 		}
282: 		else
283: 		{
284: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
285: 
286: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
287: 			{
288: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
289: 			}
290: 
291: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
296: 
297: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
298: 	{
299: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
300: 	}

309: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
310: 
311: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
312: 
313: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
314: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
315: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
316: 	 */
317: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
318: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
319: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
320: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
321: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
322: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
323: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
324: 
325: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
326: 	{
327: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
328: 		{
329: 			/* trigger send! */
330: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
331: 		}
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	return;

337: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
338: {
339: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
340: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
341: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
342: 
343: 	if (!invalid)
344: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
345: 	else
346: 	{
347: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
348: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
352: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
353: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
354: 	 */
355: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
356: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
357: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
358: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
359: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
360: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
361: 
362: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
363: 	{
364: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
365: 		{

367: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);

369: 	}

371: 	return;

374: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
375: {
376: 	/* The response carries the current RTS state, but it cannot replace an
377: 	 * outstanding ACK-pool fence.
378: 	 */
379: 	if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req)
380: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
381: 
382: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
383: 	{
384: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
385: 	}
386: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
387: 	{
388: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
389: 	}
390: 	else
391: 	{
392: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
393: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
394: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
395: 		 */
396: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
397: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
398: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
399: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
400: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
401: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
402: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
403: 	}
404: 
405: 	return;
406: }

408: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
409: {
410: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
411: 
412: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
413: 
414: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
415: 
416: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
417: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
418: 	{
419: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
420: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
421: 		return;
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
425: 
426: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
429: 	}
430: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
431: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = 1;
434: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
435: 	}
436: 	else
437: 	{
438: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
442: 	{
443: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
444: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
445: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
447: 	}
448: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
449: 	{
450: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
451: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
452: 		{
453: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
454: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
455: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
456: 			mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
457: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
458: 		}
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	if (tx_fail)
462: 	{
463: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
464: 		{
465: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
466: 			{
467: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
468: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
469: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
470: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
471: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
472: 			}
473: 			else
474: 			{
475: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
476: 			}
477: 		}
478: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
479: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
480: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
481: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
482: 		{
483: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
484: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
485: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
486: 		}
487: 		else
488: 		{
489: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
490: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
491: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
492: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
493: 		}
494: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
495: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
496: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
497: 		return;
498: 	}
499: 
500: 	/* try next Tx. */
501: 
502: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
503: 
504: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
505: 	{
506: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
507: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
508: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
509: 	}
510: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
511: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
512: 
513: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
514: 	{
515: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
516: 	}
517: 
518: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
519: 	{
520: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	return;
524: }

526: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
527: {
528: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
529: 	{
530: 		u8 peer = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
531: 
532: 		if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req &&
533: 			bk_mailbox_ack_slots_used((mailbox_endpoint_t)peer) >=
534: 			MB_UART_ACK_FENCE_WATERMARK)
535: 		{
536: 			chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 1;
537: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
538: 		}
539: 	}
540: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
541: 	{
542: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
543: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
544: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
545: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
546: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
547: 	}
548: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
549: 	{
550: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
551: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
552: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
553: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
554: 	}
555: 	else
556: 	{
557: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
558: 		{
559: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
560: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
561: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
562: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
563: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
564: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
565: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
566: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
567: 		}
568: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
569: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
570: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
571: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
572: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
573: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
574: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
575: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
576: 		else
577: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
581: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
582: }

641: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
642: {
643: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
644: 
645: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
646: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
647: 
648: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
649: 	{
650: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
651: 	}
652: 
653: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
654: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
655: 
656: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
657: 	{
658: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
659: 	}
660: 	else
661: 	{
662: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
663: 	}
664: 
665: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
666: 	{
667: 		return BK_FAIL;
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
671: 	{
672: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
673: 	}
674: 
675: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
676: 	{
677: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
678: 	}
679: 	else
680: 	{
681: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
682: 
683: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
684: 		{
685: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
686: 		}
687: 		else
688: 		{
689: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
690: 
691: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
692: 		}
693: 	}
694: 
695: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
696: 
697: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
698: 
699: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
700: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
701: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
702: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
703: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
704: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
705: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
706: 
707: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
708: 
709: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
710: 	{
711: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
712: 	}
713: 
714: 	return ret_val;
715: }

32:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
33:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
34:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
35: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200
36: #define MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN			8
37: #define MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND		1

43: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */

203: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_cnt = 0;
204: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_cnt = 0;
205: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt = 0;
206: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt = 0;
207: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt = 0;
208: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask = 0;

210: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
211: {
212: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
213: 
214: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
215: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
216: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
217: 
218: 	return ret_code;
219: }

221: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
222: {
223: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
224: }
225: 
226: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
227: {
228: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
229: 
230: 	while (1)
231: 	{
232: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
233: 		bk_err_t ret;
234: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
235: 
236: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
237: 		{
238: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
239: 			return;
240: 		}
241: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
242: 		ack_sending = 1;
243: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
244: 
245: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
246: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
247: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
248: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
249: 		{
250: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
251: 			ack_sending = 0;
252: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
253: 			return;
254: 		}
255: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
256: 		ack_count--;
257: 		ack_sending = 0;
258: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
259: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
260: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
261: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
262: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
263: 	}
264: }
265: 
266: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
267: {
268: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
269: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
270: 
271: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN)
272: 	{
273: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
274: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
275: 		return false;
276: 	}
277: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
278: 	entry->data = *data;
279: 	entry->destination = destination;
280: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
281: 	ack_count++;
282: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
283: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
284: 	return true;
285: }

287: static void mb_chnl_notify(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *log_chnl_cb_x, u8 count,
288: 			   mb_chnl_event_t event)
289: {
290: 	u8 i;
291: 
292: 	for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
293: 	{
294: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].in_used && log_chnl_cb_x[i].event_isr)
295: 			log_chnl_cb_x[i].event_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[i].isr_param, event);

299: static void mb_chnl_fail_pending(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs, u8 count)
300: {
301: 	mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
302: 	u8 i;
303: 
304: 	for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
305: 	{
306: 		if (logs[i].tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
307: 			continue;
308: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
309: 		failure.hdr.cmd = ((mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&logs[i].chnnl_tx_buff)->hdr.cmd;
310: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
311: 		logs[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
312: 		if (logs[i].tx_cmpl_isr)
313: 			logs[i].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[i].isr_param, &failure);
314: 	}
315: }

329: 
330: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
331: {
332: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
333: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
334: 	u16 			chnl_type;
335: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
336: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
337: 
338: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
339: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
340: 
341: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
342: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
343: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
344: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
345: #endif
346: 
347: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
348: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
349: 
350: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
351: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
352: 
353: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
354: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
355: 
356: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
357: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
358: 
359: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
361: 
362: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
363: 
364: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
365: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
366: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
367: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
368: 
369: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
370: 
371: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
372: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
373: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
374: 
375: 	__DMB();
376: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
377: 
378: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
379: 
380: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
381: 
382: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
383: 	{
384: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
385: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
386: 
387: 		return ret_code;
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
391: 
392: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
393: 
394: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
395: 	{
396: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	return BK_OK;
400: }
401: 
402: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
403: {
404: 	u8		log_chnl;
405: 	u8		ret_code;
406: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
407: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
408: 
409: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
410: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
411: 
412: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
413: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
414: 	{
415: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
416: 
417: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
418: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
419: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
420: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
421: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
422: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
423: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
424: 		{
425: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
426: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
427: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
428: 			return;
429: 		}
430: 
431: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
432: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
433: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
434: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
435: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
436: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
437: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
438: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
439: 		{
440: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
441: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
442: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
443: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
444: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
445: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
446: 			{
447: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
448: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
449: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
450: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
451: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
452: 			}
453: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
454: 		}
455: 		else
456: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
457: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
458: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
459: 		return;
460: 	}
461: 
462: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
463: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
464: 
465: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
466: 
467: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
468: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
469: 		return;
470: 	}
471: 
472: 
473: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
474: 	{
475: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
476: 		return;
477: 	}
478: 
479: 
480: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
481: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
482: 		return;
483: 	}
484: 
485: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
486: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
487: 
488: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
489: 	{
490: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
491: 		return;
492: 	}
493: 
494: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
495: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
496: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
497: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
498: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
499: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
500: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
501: 	{
502: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
503: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
504: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
505: 		return;
506: 	}
507: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
508: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
509: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
510: 
511: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
512: 
513: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
514: 	{
515: 		/* clear following header members. */
516: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
517: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
518: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
519: 
520: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
521: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
522: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
523: 	} else {
524: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
525: 	}
526: 
527: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
528: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
529: 	{
530: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
531: 		return;
532: 	}
533: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
534: 	{
535: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
536: 			break;
537: 	}
538: 
539: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
540: 	{
541: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
542: 		return;
543: 	}
544: 
545: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
546: 
547: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
548: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
549: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
550: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
551: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
552: 
553: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
554: 
555: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
556: 	{
557: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
558: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
559: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
560: 	}
561: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
562: 
563: 	return;
564: 
565: }

567: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
568: {
569: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
570: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
571: 
572: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
573: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
574: 
575: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
576: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
577: 
578: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
579: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
580: 
581: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
582: 
583: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
584: 		return;
585: 
586: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
587: 		return;
588: 
589: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
590: 		return;
591: 
592: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
593: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
594: 
595: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
596: 
597: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
598: 	{
599: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
600: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
601: 
602: 		return;
603: 	}
604: 
605: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
606: 	{
607: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
608: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
609: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
610: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
611: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
612: 
613: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
614: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
615: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
616: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
617: 	}
618: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
619: 	{
620: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
621: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
622: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
623: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
624: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
625: 
626: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
627: 
628: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
629: 	}
630: 	else
631: 	{
632: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
633: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
634: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
635: 	}
636: 
637: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
638: 	{
639: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
640: 		return;
641: 	}
642: 
643: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
644: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
645: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
646: 
647: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
648: 	{
649: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
650: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
651: 		return;
652: 	}
653: 	return;
654: }
655: 
656: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
657: {
658: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
659: 
660: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
661: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
662: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
663: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
664: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
665: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
666: 
667: 	/*
668: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
669: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
670: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
671: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
672: 	 */
673: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
674: 	{
675: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
676: 	}
677: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
678: 	{
679: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
680: 	}
681: }

683: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
684: {
685: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
686: 
687: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
688: 
689: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
690: 
691: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
692: 
693: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
694: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
695: 
696: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
697: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
698: 
699: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
700: 
701: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
702: 	{
703: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
704: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
705: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
706: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
707: 
708: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
709: 
710: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
711: 		{
712: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
713: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
714: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
715: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
716: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
717: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
718: 
719: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
720: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
721: 			}
722: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
723: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
724: 			return ret_code;
725: 		}
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	return BK_OK;
729: }

731: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
732: 
733: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
734: {
735: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
736: 	u16 			chnl_type;
737: 
738: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
739: 
740: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
741: 
742: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
743: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
744: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
745: #endif
746: 
747: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
748: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
749: 
750: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
751: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
752: 
753: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
754: 
755: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
756: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
757: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
758: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
759: 
760: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
761: 
762: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
763: 
764: 	/*
765: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
766: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
767: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
768: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
769: 	 */
770: 	while(1)
771: 	{
772: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
773: 
774: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
775: 		{
776: 			break;
777: 		}
778: 	}
779: 
780: 	return ret_code;
781: }

784: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
785: /*
786:   * init logical chnanel module.
787:   * return:
788:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
789:   *     failed  : fail code.
790:   *
791:   */
792: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
793: {
794: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
795: 	int				i, j;
796: 
797: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
798: 
799: 	/*
800: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
801: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
802: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
803: 	 * can race here:
804: 	 *
805: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
806: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
807: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
808: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
809: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
810: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
811: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
812: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
813: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
814: 	 *
815: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
816: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
817: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
818: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
819: 	 */
820: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
821: 	{
822: 		return BK_OK;
823: 	}
824: 
825: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
826: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
827: 	{
828: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
829: 		return BK_OK;
830: 	}
831: 
832: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
833: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
834: 	ack_read = 0;
835: 	ack_write = 0;
836: 	ack_count = 0;
837: 	ack_sending = 0;
838: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
839: 	{
840: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
841: 
842: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
843: 
844: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
845: 
846: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
847: 		{
848: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
849: 		}
850: 	}
851: 
852: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
853: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
854: 	{
855: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
856: 		return ret_code;
857: 	}
858: 
859: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
860: 
861: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
862: 	{
863: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
864: 
865: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
866: 	}
867: 
868: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
869: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
870: 
871: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
872: 
873: 	return BK_OK;
874: }

990:   * input:

992:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.

996:   *
997:   */
998: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
999: {
1000: 	u16		write_len;
1001: 
1002: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1003: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1004: 
1005: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1006: 
1007: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1008: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1009: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1010: #endif
1011: 
1012: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1013: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1014: 
1015: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1016: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1017: 
1018: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1019: 
1020: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1021: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1022: 
1023: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1024: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1025: 
1026: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1027: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1028: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1029: 
1030: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1031: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1032: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1033: 	{
1034: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1035: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1036: 	}
1037: 
1038: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1039: 	{
1040: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1041: 
1042: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;

100: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])

108:     }

118:    * receive FIFO status register.

121:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
122:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
123:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;

130:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
131:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
132:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);

184: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
185: {
186:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
187:   int ret;
188: 
189:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
190:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
191:    */
192: 
193:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
194:     {
195:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
196:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
197:       g_processing_order = 0;
198:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
199:         {
200:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
201:           break;
202:         }
203: 
204:       desc->used = false;
205:     }
206: 
207:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
208:     {
209:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
210:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
211:       g_processing_order = 0;
212:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
213:         {
214:           break;
215:         }
216: 
217:       desc->used = false;
218:     }
219: }

221: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
222: {
223:   uintptr_t rdata0;
224:   uintptr_t rdata1;
225:   uintptr_t sidreg;
226:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
227:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
228: 
229:   (void)irq;
230:   (void)context;
231:   (void)arg;
232: 
233:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
234:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
235:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
236:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
237:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
238:     {
239:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
240:     }
241:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
242:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
243:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
244: 
245:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
246:     {
247:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
248:       uint32_t address;
249:       uint32_t length;
250:       uint8_t source;
251: 
252:       if (cpu == 0)
253:         {
254:           mbox_process_desc();
255:         }
256: 
257:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
258:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
259:         {
260:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
261:           break;
262:         }
263: 
264:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
265:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
266:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
267: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
268:       if (length == 0)
269:         {
270:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
271:             {
272:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
273:                 {
274:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
275:                 }
276: 
277:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
278:             }
279:           else
280:             {
281:               if (cpu == 0)
282:                 {
283:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
284:                 }
285:             }
286: 
287:           continue;
288:         }
289: #endif
290: 
291:       if (cpu != 0)
292:         {
293:           continue;
294:         }
295: 
296:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
297:         {
298:           continue;
299:         }
300: 
301:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
302:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
303:              sizeof(desc->message));
304:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
305:       desc->used = true;
306:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
307:       mbox_process_desc();
308:     }
309: 
310:   if (cpu == 0)
311:     {
312:       mbox_process_desc();
313:     }
314: 
315:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
316:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
317:     {
318:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
319:     }
320: 
321:   return OK;
322: }

380:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and

382:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.

388:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
389: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
390:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
391:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
392:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
393:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
394: #endif
395:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
396:   mbox_clear_errors(0);

398:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);

401:       return ret;

404:   g_mbox_ready = true;
405: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
406:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
407: #endif
408:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
409:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);

210: static void ap_bridge_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
211: {

213: 	u8 line[AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
214: 	u16 line_length = 0;
215: 	u8 active_mode = AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG;
216: 	bool line_continues = false;

218: 	(void)arg;

229: 			line_length ? AP_BRIDGE_LOG_FLUSH_MS : 20);

233: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();

243: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
244: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
245: 		{
246: 			ready_clear |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
247: 		}
248: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= ready_set;
249: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~ready_clear;
250: 		/* poll() may complete recovery in the same iteration that consumes an
251: 		 * older timeout/reset event.  The driver's current state is the final
252: 		 * authority for the MBUART gate, so a stale event cannot clear a newer
253: 		 * READY notification permanently.
254: 		 */
255: 		if (bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
256: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
257: 		else
258: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
259: 		s_ap_bridge.link_ready =
260: 			(s_ap_bridge.ready_flags & AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL) ==
261: 			AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL && bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0);
262: 
263: 		if (s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation !=
264: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_generation)
265: 		{
266: 			if (line_length)
267: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
268: 			line_length = 0;
269: 			line_continues = false;
270: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.requested_mode;
271: 			s_ap_bridge.output_mode = active_mode;
272: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation =
273: 				s_ap_bridge.mode_generation;
274: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
275: 		}
276: 
277: 		do
278: 		{
279: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
280: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
281: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
282: 			{
283: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data(input, input_length))
284: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
285: 				continue;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
289: 			{
290: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
291: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
292: 				{
293: 					bool complete = input[index] == '\n';
294: 
295: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length,
296: 							     !line_continues);
297: 					line_length = 0;
298: 					line_continues = !complete;
299: 				}

301: 		} while (input_length != 0);

303: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
304: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
305: 		{
306: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
307: 			line_length = 0;
308: 			line_continues = true;
309: 		}

311: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
312: 
313: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
314: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
315: 		{
316: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
317: 
318: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
319: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
320: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
321: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
322: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
323: 			if ((ready_before & (AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC |
324: 					     AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)) ==
325: 				(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC) &&
326: 				(u32)(now - s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms) >= 1000)

335: 		}
336: 	}

404: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
405: {
406: 	u16 written = 0;
407: 
408: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
409: 		return 0;
410: 
411: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
412: 	while (written < length)
413: 	{
414: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
415: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
416: 			break;
417: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
418: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
419: 	}
420: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
421: 	if (written < length)
422: 	{
423: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
424: 	}

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)
58: {
59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;
67: 
68: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* ACK slots are released only by a later command ACK fence.  FIFO empty
91: 	 * alone does not prove that the peer finished copying the pointed data.
92: 	 */
93: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
94: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
95: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
96: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
97: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
98: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
99: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
100: }

119: 		if (((ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0) != priority)
120: 			continue;

122: 			oldest = &rx_desc[i];

127: static mbox0_stable_slot_t *mbox0_alloc_slot(u8 dst, u8 ctrl,
128: 					     u8 *kind, u8 *index)
129: {
130: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
131: 	u8 i;
132: 
133: 	if (ctrl == (MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX | MBOX0_CTRL_RESET))
134: 	{
135: 		if (slots->reset_used)
136: 			return NULL;
137: 		slots->reset_used = 1;
138: 		slots->reset_order = ++slots->publish_order;
139: 		*kind = 2;
140: 		return &slots->reset;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
144: 	{
145: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
146: 		{
147: 			if (!slots->ack_used[i])
148: 			{
149: 				slots->ack_used[i] = 1;
150: 				slots->ack_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
151: 				*kind = 1;
152: 				*index = i;
153: 				return &slots->ack[i];
154: 			}
155: 		}
156: 		return NULL;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
160: 	{
161: 		if (slots->sync_used)
162: 			return NULL;
163: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
164: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
165: 		*kind = 3;
166: 		return &slots->sync;
167: 	}
168: 
169: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
170: 	{
171: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
172: 		{
173: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
174: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
175: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
176: 			*kind = 0;
177: 			*index = i;
178: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
179: 		}
180: 	}
181: 
182: 	return NULL;

203: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)
204: {
205: 	u8 dst;
206: 
207: 	u32 flags = rtos_disable_int();
208: 	for (dst = 0; dst < MBOX_CHNL_NUM; dst++)
209: 	{
210: 		if (dst != MAILBOX_CPU0)
211: 			mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
212: 	}
213: 	mbox0_drv_poll();
214: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
215: 
216: 	while (1)
217: 	{
218: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t desc;
219: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t *selected;
220: 
221: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
222: 		if (!rx_count)
223: 		{
224: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
225: 			break;
226: 		}
227: 		selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(true);
228: 		if (!selected)
229: 			selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(false);
230: 		if (!selected ||
231: 			(((selected->data.param0 >> 12) & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 &&
232: 			 upper_rx_ready && !upper_rx_ready()))
233: 		{
234: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
235: 			break;
236: 		}
237: 		desc = *selected;
238: 		selected->used = 0;
239: 		rx_count--;
240: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
241: 		if (mailbox_callback[desc.source])
242: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);
243: 
244: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
245: 		mbox0_drv_poll();
246: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
247: 	}
248: }

250: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
251: {
252: 	u32 address;
253: 	u32 source;
254: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
255: 	u8 i;
256: 
257: 	if (!msg)
258: 		return;
259: 
260: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
261: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
262: 	{
263: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
264: 		return;
265: 	}
266: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
267: 	{
268: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
269: 		return;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	address = msg->data[0];
273: 	if (address & 0x3u)
274: 	{
275: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
276: 		return;
277: 	}
278: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
279: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
280: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
281: 	{
282: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
283: 		return;
284: 	}
285: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
286: 	{
287: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
288: 		return;
289: 	}
290: 
291: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
292: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
293: #endif
294: 	__DMB();
295: 	desc = NULL;
296: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
297: 	{
298: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
299: 		{
300: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
301: 			break;
302: 		}
303: 	}
304: 	if (!desc)
305: 	{
306: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
307: 		return;
308: 	}
309: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
310: 	desc->source = source;
311: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
312: 	desc->used = 1;
313: 	rx_count++;
314: 
315: }

353: 	u8 ctrl;
354: 	u8 kind = 0;
355: 	u8 index = 0;
356: 	int ret_code;
357: 
358: 	(void)arg;
359: 	if (src != MAILBOX_CPU0 || dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
360: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
361: 	if (!data)
362: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;

365: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)

367: 	if (fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL)
368: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
369: 
370: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
371: 	mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
372: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
373: 	if (!slot)
374: 	{
375: 		adapter_diag.tx_slot_busy++;
376: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
377: 	}
378: 
379: 	memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
380: 	memcpy(&slot->data, data, sizeof(slot->data));
381: 	mailbox_slots[dst].fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
382: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
383: 	SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((u32 *)slot, sizeof(*slot));
384: #endif

386: 	message.data[0] = (u32)&slot->data;
387: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);
388: 	message.dest_cpu = dst;
389: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
390: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
391: 	{
392: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
393: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
394: 	}
395: 	return BK_OK;

398: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
399: {
400: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
401: 	u32 completed_order;
402: 	u8 i;
403: 
404: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
405: 		return;
406: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
407: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
408: 		return;
409: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
410: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
411: 	{
412: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
413: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
414: 	}
415: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
416: 	{
417: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
418: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
419: 	}
420: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
421: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
422: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
423: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
424: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
425: }

472: 			}

476: 			}

552: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
553:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
554: {
555:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
556: 
557:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
558:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
559:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
560:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
561:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
562:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
563:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
564: }

566: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
567: {
568:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
569:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
570:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
571: }
572: 
573: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
574: {
575:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
576:   struct active_transaction *active;
577:   bool replay;
578:   int result;
579: 
580:   active = busy_probe();
581:   if (active == NULL)
582:     {
583:       active = &g_active;
584:     }
585: 
586:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
587:     {
588:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
589:       return;
590:     }
591: 
592:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
593:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
594:     {
595:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
596: 
597:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
598:       return;
599:     }
600: 
601:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
602:     {
603:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
604:       return;
605:     }
606: 
607:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
608:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
609: 
610:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
611:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
612:     {
613:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
614:     }
615: 
616:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
617:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
618:   if (replay)
619:     {
620:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
621:       unsigned int i;
622: 
623:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
624:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
625:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
626:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
627:        */
628: 
629:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
630:       g_active.quarantine = false;
631:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
632:         {
633:           if (i != replay_index)
634:             {
635:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
636:             }
637:         }
638: 
639:       select_recovery_epoch();
640:       (void)dispatch_locked();
641:       return;
642:     }
643: 
644:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
645: 
646:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
647:     {
648:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
649:         {
650:           release_recovery_slots();
651:           g_recovery_index = 0;
652:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
653:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
654:         }
655:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
656:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
657:         {
658:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
659:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
660:            */
661:         }
662:       else
663:         {
664:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
665:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
666:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
667:         }
668:     }
669: 
670:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
671:            result < 0)
672:     {
673:       begin_abort(result);
674:     }
675: 
676:   (void)dispatch_locked();
677: }

679: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
680: {
681:   struct ack_slot *slot;
682:   unsigned int rx_index;
683:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
684:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
685:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
686:   uint8_t state = 0;
687:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
688: 
689:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
690:     {
691:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
692:       if (slot == NULL)
693:         {
694:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
695:           return -EAGAIN;
696:         }
697:     }
698:   else
699:     {
700:       slot = NULL;
701:     }
702: 
703:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
704:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
705:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
706:     {
707:       g_stats.bad_header++;
708:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
709:     }
710:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
711:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
712:     {
713:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
714:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
715:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
716:         {
717:           if (slot != NULL)
718:             {
719:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
720:             }
721: 
722:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
723:           return -EAGAIN;
724:         }
725:       else if (ret < 0)
726:         {
727:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;

<thinking>**Preparing comprehensive final with line citations****Checking CP FIFO dimensions and AP async queue behavior**</thinking>
The last liveness defect is on the AP side: `bk7258_mailbox_send_wire()` deliberately converts physical `-EAGAIN` into success after leaving the logical request queued. UART then sets `transaction_busy`, but the 200 ms watchdog starts only once `send_slot()` eventually succeeds. If CP’s FIFO remains full, neither the queued STATE nor a pending RESET has any timeout, so recovery can remain in `PROBING` or `ABORTING` forever.
